justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Systematic reviews: no benefit over dose-matched conventional PT. Proprioceptive loading hypothesis not confirmed.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Facility-based training; requires specialized suit and clinic access; significant equipment cost barrier.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to pediatric neurological populations with specific suit therapy facilities; very limited scope.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Almost exclusively self-pay; not covered by major payers; intensive billing as PT possible but payer denial common.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Very limited employer demand; primarily specialized pediatric neuro therapy centers.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Families invest significantly; expectation-outcome gap can be disappointing.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Pediatric intensive model (TheraSuit/NeuroSuit) is famously cash-pay; families travel and pay out of pocket for blocks.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Intensive packages command $3-6k+ per block — strong premium pricing.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Equipment-based and visually distinctive; differentiates a pediatric neuro clinic.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Other clinicians can be trained to deliver it, so a clinic can scale around the suit and equipment investment.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Strong demand within CP/pediatric neuro families who actively seek it out.
justifications.business.efficiency: Equipment is expensive and training plus space requirements are substantial.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Viewed skeptically in academia; commercial equipment brand with weak standing.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Limited peer-reviewed literature, mostly small or industry-adjacent studies.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Marginal curricular relevance beyond a brief mention in pediatric neuro.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Evidence is thin and mixed; no strong RCT support.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Essentially never appears in academic job postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: High cost and time for negligible academic return.
